title: Hospital HMI / lane UI fault acknowledge-and-retry check
summary: Use the Hospital HMI / lane UI at UPS Haslet TX (TXRTH) to acknowledge a displayed fault, retry the operation without unplugging the Hospital HMI / lane UI, confirm that the affected tote is tote 28, and verify that the site reports the condition as all good.
when_to_use: Use this Hospital HMI / lane UI check when the Hospital HMI / lane UI displays a fault associated with a hospital-station tote and an acknowledge-and-retry response is appropriate.
not_for: Do not use this as a recovery sequence for a stuck task; the incident identifies a stuck-task visibility limitation on the Hospital HMI / lane UI but does not provide a reusable stuck-task recovery sequence.
Do not unplug the Hospital HMI / lane UI as a troubleshooting action.

steps.title: Inspect the displayed Hospital HMI / lane UI fault
steps.instruction: Open the Hospital HMI / lane UI and inspect the live station screen for the reported fault. Do not unplug the Hospital HMI / lane UI.
steps.purpose: Confirm that the reported fault is present on the live Hospital HMI / lane UI before taking the acknowledge-and-retry action.
steps.expected_result: The reported fault is visible on the Hospital HMI / lane UI and the live screen is available for interaction.
steps.healthy_condition: The Hospital HMI / lane UI remains displayed and usable, with the reported fault visible for acknowledgement.
steps.failure_condition: The Hospital HMI / lane UI cannot be accessed, the reported fault is not visible, or the screen is not usable for the next action.
stop_or_escalate_if: The Hospital HMI / lane UI cannot be accessed or the fault is not visible.
The HMI appears to require unplugging; do not unplug it and escalate for further support.

actions.label: Inspect Hospital HMI / lane UI fault
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI / lane UI and confirm that the fault is displayed; do not unplug the HMI.

steps.title: Acknowledge the fault and retry the operation
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI / lane UI, select the acknowledge control and retry the operation. Do not unplug the Hospital HMI / lane UI.
steps.purpose: Apply the incident-supported acknowledge-and-retry response to the displayed Hospital HMI / lane UI fault.
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI / lane UI accepts the acknowledgement and the operation enters a retry state rather than remaining blocked by the same displayed fault.
steps.healthy_condition: The retry proceeds on the Hospital HMI / lane UI without the reported fault continuing to block the operation.
steps.failure_condition: The acknowledgement or retry does not take effect, or the same fault remains after the retry.
stop_or_escalate_if: The Hospital HMI / lane UI does not accept the acknowledgement or retry.

actions.label: Acknowledge and retry
actions.exact_action: Select the HMI acknowledge control, then retry the operation.

steps.title: Confirm tote 28 and the cleared Hospital HMI / lane UI state
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI / lane UI and with the site contact, confirm that the tote at the hospital station is tote 28 and verify that the site reports the condition as all good.
steps.purpose: Validate that the retry addressed the affected tote and that the site condition is clear.
steps.expected_result: The tote at the hospital station is confirmed as tote 28 and the site reports that everything is good.
steps.healthy_condition: The Hospital HMI / lane UI shows or supports confirmation of tote 28, and the site reports an all-good condition.
steps.failure_condition: Tote 28 cannot be confirmed, or the site cannot report an all-good condition after the retry.
stop_or_escalate_if: The site cannot report an all-good state.

actions.label: Confirm tote ID and cleared state
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the tote at the hospital station is tote 28 and verify that the site reports the condition as all good.
